name: Mark vs Rita: hoe de VVD bijna ten onder ging
original_name: Mark vs Rita: hoe de VVD bijna ten onder ging
overview: In the two-part documentary Mark vs. Rita, a picture is painted of the bitter power struggle between the two political heavyweights of the VVD. Party colleagues and acquaintances of Rutte and Verdonk speak in detail on television for the first time about what transpired in front of and behind the scenes.
